title: Wait until it is ready
summary: pthread_cond_wait in a while loop, and the signal that wakes it.
hints: Waiter: `lock; while (!ready) pthread_cond_wait(&c, &m); unlock;`. Setter: `lock; ready = 1; pthread_cond_signal(&c); unlock;`.

`pthread_cond_wait` releases the mutex while it sleeps and takes it again before it returns, so it must be called with the mutex held. The `while` (not `if`) protects against waking up when the condition is still false.
